newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end nearly steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end nearly steady in thin trade.

text.p: Manila stocks finished nearly unchanged in thin trade on Tuesday as investors bided for time until the next market moving news, traders said.
"The market is very tentative now as investors are waiting for the next big news such as (nine month) GNP figures," Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc said.
The main index ended slightly up by 0.03 percent at 3,047.74 points. Value of shares traded was at 2.4 billion pesos.
Reyes said though a higher GNP figure compared to the year-ago nine month period was a foregone conclusion, the actual announcement expected next week would still spur the market.
The index crawled up at close on the rise of Metrobank and Petron Corp as well as late buying in Benpres, traders said.
Punters took to secondliners such as gaming and property concern Belle Corp, one of the most heavily traded issues. Decliners beat advancers 63 to 46 with 76 issues unchanged.
The index will likely move sideways as the market consolidates for the rest of the week, said Felix Barrientos, trader at ING Barings Securities. - KATHERINE ESPINA 63 2 841-8937 Fax 8176267
